groups.title: Seating
groups.sub: Every seat is wipe-clean, felt or nylon-glided for the checker floor, and sized to the 0.45 m table gaps.

items.name: Cane-back dining chair
items.mat: Ash frame, walnut stain · open woven rattan back · 40 mm foam seat pad in leatherette (olive, orange, red, cream: never two the same at one table) · felt + nylon glides
items.note: Same cane chair as the 3D model. Seat pad ties on, so pads are replaceable. Order the chairs from one maker in one batch so the stain matches.

items.name: Velvet high-back bar stool
items.size: Ø 0.42 seat · seat 0.76 H · back to 1.10 · 0.6 m centres
items.mat: Performance velvet in sand (water-repellent, 50,000+ rubs) · brass-finish steel legs + foot ring · swivel with return

items.name: Teak garden bench with backrest

items.name: Folding high chair
items.mat: Powder-coated steel + wipe-clean seat

groups.title: Tables

groups.title: Bar, back bar & service
groups.sub: The bar is the room's signature: a glowing front, marble top, brass rail and a floating glass rack. Equipment (kegs, chiller, ice, glasswasher) is on the Simplex quotes sheet; this list is what you see and touch.

items.name: Bar counter carcass

items.name: Bar top
items.size: 2.20 × 0.75 × 0.03 · 12 mm eased edge · 0.25 overhang for knees
items.mat: Honed white Makrana marble, impregnating sealer · re-seal every 6 months

items.name: Bar front panels
items.size: 3 panels · 0.90 H · framed in black steel
items.mat: Black brass-wire mesh over amber translucent onyx-look panels, back-lit with a 2700 K LED strip (24 V, dimmable) · LED kick-strip below
items.note: Real onyx works but costs 3 times as much. The resin panel gives the same glow and is easier to replace if cracked.

items.name: Brass foot rail

items.mat: Solid brass tube, clear-lacquered, bolted to the steel frame

items.name: Back bar cabinetry

items.name: Emerald back-bar tile

items.name: Floating shelves

items.name: Brass glass-rack gantry
items.size: 1.8 L × 0.74 W · lower tier 2.30 m (stemware hangs by the foot), upper glass shelf 2.58 m
items.mat: Lacquered brass frame, glass shelf, hung from the slab on four Ø 8 black steel rods

items.name: "On Tap" chalkboard + soju riser

items.name: Server station

groups.title: Air, fans & ventilation
groups.sub: Two ACs cool the room; two slow fans mix the air so the AC can run at 26 °C instead of 24. Everything that is hot and noisy sits on the side strip, because the flats are above.

items.name: Split air conditioner 2.0 TR · front

items.mat: Inverter, 5-star, R32, Wi-Fi, high-wall · condensate piped out to the side strip · outdoor unit 0.80 × 0.55 × 0.30 on the right wall at 3.0 m
items.where: Right wall, z 1.2 · outdoor unit on the side strip
items.note: Ask for the anti-corrosion (blue-fin) coil: Goa is salt air. Not on backup power.

items.name: Split air conditioner 2.0 TR · back
items.size: Indoor 1.1 × 0.34 × 0.25 · centre at 3.1 m on the kitchen front wall (x −1.0)

lux: 100–150 lux at the table top, 2200 K
circuits: Bar: gantry, front glow, back bar
saves: 13 lines (L3, L8, L9, D1–D3, F5, C5, C7, S4, B9, W1, V3) wait for the first months.
Gantry (B8 + L4) as the first upgrade
The bar still glows from the front panel and back bar; hang the glass rack once trade is steady. Plan the four slab anchors now.
Garden set in sealed acacia instead of teak
About 30% cheaper; expect to re-oil twice a year and replace in 4–5 monsoons instead of 10+.
Bar front in laminate with an LED strip
Skip the mesh and onyx panels; keep the marble and the brass rail. Saves about half of B3 but loses the glow.
checks: F1 at (-0.45, 1.50): plan clearance to nearest pendant globe 0.59 m, to nearest lantern 0.23 m; F2 at (-0.45, 3.90): plan clearance to nearest pendant globe 0.98 m, to nearest lantern 0.93 m, to gantry 0.23 m, to wash block face 0.15 m. Blade 2.75 m, rod 1.4 m. Re-check on site with the spiral duct and the real pendant drops.
Seat 0.76 under a 1.04 counter leaves 0.28 m; the brass rail at 0.22 m is within a seated foot's reach.

Seven chairs (4 right, 3 left) have their backs 0.03 m from the wall in the 3D model, so they cannot be pulled back. Guests step in from the table end. If this feels tight in the mock-up, swap the wall-side chairs for a 0.42 m cane-and-leatherette banquette: same covers, easier entry. Your call.

Jute globes, ivy, reclaimed wood and the facade neon all burn or sit near wiring. Specified: LED filament only (4 W), flame-retardant spray on the jute, fire-retardant ivy, fire-retardant clear coat on the reclaimed wood. Confirm the finishes with the fire NOC advisor before ordering.
Lacquered brass, marine-grade powder coat, A4 stainless outside, blue-fin coil on the ACs. Bare brass and mild steel go green and rust within one monsoon.
Fans on rubber isolators, speakers on rubber pads with a limiter, no bass speaker on the slab, AC outdoor units and exhaust on the side strip.
Seal the underside and end grain of every timber piece, use performance velvet, seal the marble, and run the AC on dry mode overnight in the monsoon so the pendants and chairs do not mould.

Planning ranges for Goa in 2026, supply and fit, GST extra, from typical Indian trade rates. They are not quotes. Get three quotes per line, and treat anything with a custom maker (bar, gantry, neon, mural) as ±25%.
